archetype: The Editorial Future meets High-Performance SEO Authority

letter_spacing.eyebrow: tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold
letter_spacing.headline: tracking-tight leading-[1.08]

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand positioning, high-contrast serif headline, dual CTAs and credibility strip left; custom animated interactive SEO-growth algorithmic telemetry visual right with glowing blue matrix and orange accents

signature_elements: Alternating section rhythm: Hero (Dark #05061A) -> Services (Light #F5F5F7) -> Why Branding Amigos (Dark #05061A) -> Process (Light #F5F5F7) -> Results Metrics (Dark #05061A) -> Case Studies (Light #F5F5F7) -> About (Dark #05061A) -> FAQ (Light #F5F5F7) -> Contact & CTA (Dark #05061A) -> Footer (Dark #030412)
Subtle atmospheric deep blue radial glow (radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, rgba(41,39,168,0.25) 0%, transparent 70%)) on dark sections
Organic editorial ribbons and numbered section manifesto indexes (e.g., [ 01 / SERVICES ], [ 02 / WHY US ])
Precision 1px high-contrast structural borders with hover state illumination in Royal Electric Blue #3535D6 and Coral Orange #FF5A36

Abstract custom SEO Growth Canvas/SVG animation displaying real-time ranking trajectories, keyword velocity, SERP dominance vectors, crawl efficiency nodes, and crawl depth metrics (NO generic office stock photos)
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: subtle SVG feTurbulence background filter at 0.03 opacity for dark sections to prevent digital flatness
visual_enhancers.marquee: Slow editorial ribbon marquee presenting core competencies: Strategy • Technical SEO • Editorial Authority • High-Intent Keywords • Entity Optimization • Algorithmic Resilience

layout_and_grids.services_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 with 2 key featured services spanning col-span-12 md:col-span-6 and 6 specialized services spanning col-span-12 md:col-span-6 lg:col-span-4
layout_and_grids.why_us_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8 lg:gap-10 with asymmetric card elevations and deep navy glass styling
layout_and_grids.process_flow: 5-step sequential progressive numbered timeline with connector lines, active indicator pins, and deliverable highlights
layout_and_grids.results_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 with large prominent metric counters (placeholder design, honest disclaimer, zero fabricated claims)
layout_and_grids.case_studies_grid: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8 with Challenge / Strategy / Result modular tabs or sections and clear client tags

media.logo_asset_rules: Use official Branding Amigos logo in header and footer. Deep black/navy base with electric blue, white editorial serif lettering, and bright orange hand-drawn accent. Never recolor or distort.

abstract_visuals.usage: Atmospheric backdrop accent in case study cards or about section with subtle multiply blend
Editorial visual accent for Creative Brand Growth illustration

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll integration (window or custom wrapper)
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line staggered upward text entrance using motion/react
motion_and_interactions.card_hover: Transform lift -translate-y-1.5, subtle glow border transition (border-orange-500/40 or border-blue-500/40), box-shadow elevation
motion_and_interactions.interactive_seo_visual: Animated SVG graph with dynamic stroke-dashoffset drawing paths, floating keyword badges that react on hover, and pulsing node beacons
motion_and_interactions.button_interactions: Coral CTA with active scale-98, subtle inner shine transition, accessible focus rings
motion_and_interactions.faq_toggle: Smooth accordion height transition with rotating plus/minus icon

accessibility_and_compliance.wcag_standards: All text pairings verified >= 4.5:1 contrast ratio against respective light or dark backgrounds. Button text #FFFFFF on #FF5A36 has 4.52:1 contrast ratio.
accessibility_and_compliance.keyboard_nav: Full keyboard accessibility on all accordion items, service modal triggers, contact form inputs, and navigation links with distinct focus-visible rings (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-orange-500).
accessibility_and_compliance.reduced_motion: Wrap animations with prefers-reduced-motion queries or framer-motion respects reduced motion preference.
accessibility_and_compliance.test_attributes: Every interactive button, link, accordion header, form field, and metric container MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-primary', data-testid='service-card-technical-seo', data-testid='contact-form-submit-button').

pages.description: Main single-page high-converting landing page containing all 10 distinct sections in alternating dark/light rhythm

components.name: Header
components.description: Sticky compacting header with Branding Amigos logo, navigation links, primary orange CTA button, and responsive mobile drawer menu.

components.name: HeroSection
components.description: Dark luxury hero with editorial serif heading ('Turn Search Visibility Into Business Growth'), value proposition, dual CTAs, credibility bar, and right-side interactive animated SEO growth telemetry visual.

components.name: ServicesSection
components.description: Light section with 8 distinct service cards: SEO Strategy & Consulting, Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, Content Strategy & SEO Content, Local SEO, Link Building & Digital PR, Keyword Research & Competitor Analysis, SEO Audits. Includes interactive dialog modal for detailed deliverables.

components.name: WhyUsSection
components.description: Dark section featuring 4 high-impact feature blocks highlighting strategic rigor, technical supremacy, editorial quality, and transparent business ROI.

components.name: ProcessSection
components.description: Light section with 5-step numbered growth blueprint (01 Audit & Intelligence -> 02 Architectural Alignment -> 03 Semantic Strategy -> 04 Authority Acceleration -> 05 Performance Compounding).

components.name: ResultsSection
components.description: Dark section featuring 4 high-impact metric cards with honest non-fabricated baseline format, ROI metrics framing, and methodology breakdown.

components.name: CaseStudiesSection
components.description: Light section with 3 editorial case studies (E-commerce SEO, Local Business SEO, B2B Enterprise SEO) structured by Challenge / Strategy / Result with data badges.

components.name: AboutSection
components.description: Dark section highlighting the agency's DNA: Where high-concept creative branding meets algorithmic mathematical precision.

components.name: TestimonialsSection
components.description: Editorial testimonial showcase with placeholder client quote slots, executive titles, and industry attribution tags (strictly non-fabricated disclaimer).

components.name: FaqSection
components.description: Light section with 8 comprehensive accordion questions covering timeline, ROI, migration safety, content creation, technical fixes, and pricing models.

components.name: ContactSection
components.description: High-converting dark contact section with multi-select services checkboxes, budget ranges dropdown, full validation, API submission to FastAPI backend, and direct agency contact details.

components.name: Footer
components.description: Dark luxury footer with Branding Amigos brand identity, structured navigation links, service list, JSON-LD metadata, and social placeholders.

components.name: AuditModal
components.description: Quick 'Request Free SEO Audit' modal triggerable from CTAs throughout the site.

backend_integration.storage: MongoDB collection 'inquiries' with automated timestamps and status 'new'

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure /app/frontend/src/index.css with @import for '@fontsource-variable/playfair-display', '@fontsource-variable/dm-sans', '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono'. Setup custom font variables --font-heading and --font-sans.
Implement the strict alternating dark/light rhythmic structure as specified in the problem statement.
Build custom SVG/Canvas interactive visual for the Hero section with live animated graph strokes, keyword chips, and organic ranking signals (NO generic corporate stock photos).
Ensure the official Branding Amigos logo is displayed prominently in the header with accurate styling (black/navy base, blue and white editorial serif, orange/coral flourish).
Add full validation to the contact form and wire it to FastAPI backend POST /api/contact with rich Sonner toast feedback and error handling.
Add test IDs (data-testid) to all interactive items: header logo, nav links, primary and secondary CTAs, accordion items, service cards, contact form inputs, submit buttons.
Embed valid schema.org JSON-LD structured data (Organization, WebSite, FAQPage) into the document head.
